description: Drum & bass: rolling breaks, reese bass, rave stabs. High-speed runs, downhill, overtakes.

Sunny indie electronic: soft four-on-the-floor, warm pads, arpeggios. Scenery and golden hour.
Gritty blues riff over a foot-stomp beat. Accent only: intro sting / tension, never a whole track.
Liquid drum & bass: rolling but uplifting, pads, wordless vocals. Outro.
The brief's long-video arc: blues sting -> funk -> dnb -> indie -> liquid outro. Stems alongside (demo_arc_140s_drums/bass/music/vocals.wav).
